builds.hypothesis:
Sejuani throws her True Ice bola, Stunning and revealing the first enemy champion hit for [1] second and dealing [125 / 150 / 175 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage.

If the bola travels at least 25% of its range, it Stuns and reveals for [1.5] seconds instead. It then also creates an ice storm that Slows surrounding enemies by [80]% for [2] seconds. All affected enemies take [200 / 300 / 400 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

Cast beyond 25% range, leave target in storm and log primary/storm separately; compare near cast. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Rune reasoning: Sejuani — Glacial Prison: Use adaptive stats for the actual damage helper and a finisher matching the starting enemy/owner HP. The keystone proc is measured separately; damage type alone does not justify attack speed, crit, or an ultimate modifier. Ability basis: Sejuani throws her True Ice bola, Stunning and revealing the first enemy champion hit for [1] second and dealing [125 / 150 / 175 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage. If the bola travels at least 25% of its range, it Stuns and reveals for [1.5] seconds instead. It then Deathfire Touch: Burn is a separate packet with real refresh/ramp rules, not extra native ticks. Axiom Arcanist: Eligibility-tested ultimate modifier; classification and true/pet/on-hit/revive exceptions are not inferred from slot alone. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Bloodline: Exactly15 earned stacks give85HP; equipped Riftmaker converts actual bonus HP into AP for this helper. No additional lifesteal damage or free stacks. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Axiom targets eligible native ultimate output. Check single-target versus area classification, and pet/on-hit/transform/true-damage exceptions. Its takedown refund is not extra damage inside one fixed cast. Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. Bloodline: exactly15 earned legend stacks for85HP; read the actual Riftmaker HP-to-AP result before the scored event.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Highest-number candidate, not proof of mathematical maximum. Use current stored source values and verify all conditional multipliers. Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs. Report observed damage only while the target survives; any theoretical full-window overkill is a separate raw-potential metric, not damage actually dealt.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Shadowflame, Zhonya's Hourglass, Banshee's Veil, Riftmaker. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

builds.name: Winter's Wrath: HP and AP physical sweep
builds.summary: Investigate high both Winter's Wrath impacts output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high both Winter's Wrath impacts output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.

Sejuani swings her flail, dealing [5 / 15 / 25 / 35 / 45 + (0.3) × AP + (0.04) × Stat(12)] physical damage and Knocking Back minions and jungle monsters. She then lashes out again, dealing [5 / 25 / 45 / 65 / 85 + (0.6) × AP + (0.08) × Stat(12)] physical damage and briefly Slowing targets.
